# Progressive Materialist Naturalism (PMN)

> A naturalist philosophical framework for analyzing material reality, minimizing structural suffering, and maximizing genuine becoming. Authored by Nova Dharma.

PMN is a comprehensive, non-ideal structural philosophy spanning epistemology, ontology, institutional critique, political strategy, and existential praxis.

## Start Here: Small Plain-Text Files

> **Fetcher note (sizes).** The whole corpus is ~330k words (~450k tokens) and most fetchers truncate long files, so `llms-full.txt` is usually read only up to its glossary. Every section is therefore also published as its own `text/plain` file (largest ~55 KB), and every Part as one plain-text file. Start from the index and fetch only what you need.

- [Plain-Text Section Index](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/index.txt): Every one of the 235 sections in reading order, each with the full URL of its own small `.txt` file and its size. Fetch this first.
- [Static HTML Edition](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/read/): The same manuscript as plain HTML pages, one per section, readable without JavaScript. The interactive reader at the site root needs JavaScript; crawlers that do not run it should use this.
- [Sitemap](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/sitemap.xml): Every indexable URL of the site.

## Machine-Readable Manifests & Endpoints

> **Fetcher note.** GitHub Pages serves `.md` files as `text/markdown`, and
> several AI web fetchers drop that media type before reading the body — the
> file is present and current, it simply never arrives. Every Markdown artifact
> below is therefore also published complete in one `text/plain` file.

- [Complete Content, Single File (text/plain)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/llms-full.txt): AI grounding documentation plus the full ~330k word corpus in one file, served as text/plain for fetchers that refuse text/markdown. Use this if a `.md` URL fails.
- [Standard AI Discovery Index (Text)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/llms.txt): Standard llms.txt entry point.
- [Structured API Manifest (JSON)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/llms.json): Machine-readable JSON index with metadata, part schemas, and data endpoints.
- [AI Grounding Documentation (Markdown)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/llms.md): Formatted Markdown reference with complete architectural tables.
- [Flat AI Corpus (~330k words)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/pmn_corpus_for_ai.md): Complete uncompressed flat text corpus optimized for single-file ingestion.

## Canonical Manuscript & Publications

- [Full Manuscript (Markdown)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/PMN_Latest.md): Complete ~330k word uncompressed corpus of PMN Framework v126 from Preface through Coda, Intellectual Debts, and Bibliography.
- [Full Manuscript (PDF)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/PMN_Latest.pdf): Official typeset publication (~632 pages).
- [Interactive Reader Platform](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/): Offline-capable React reader with keyboard navigation, search, and glossary.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/novadharma-hub/pmn-framework): Source repository and release assets.
- [Active Version Metadata](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/version.json): Current canonical release version.

## Core Architectural Modules

Each link is the whole Part as plain text. Parts III, VII, X, XIII and XV are large (150–300 KB); for those, fetch single sections listed in txt/index.txt instead.

- [Preface — Preface](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_Preface.txt): How to read the framework, methodological warnings, and intellectual debt boundaries.
- [I — How We Know: The Epistemological Foundation](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_I.txt): Probabilistic determinism, epistemic authority, and information asymmetry.
- [II — What Exists: The Ontological Foundation](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_II.txt): Materialist ontology, adaptive materialism, and open passage.
- [III — The Biological Foundation: From Physiology to Institution](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_III.txt): The biological floor, typology of suffering, and non-human sentients (§3.4c-ii).
- [IV — What Matters: Ethics, Value, and the Evaluative Commitment](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_IV.txt): Becoming as primary evaluative criterion, dignity, autonomy, and the minimal anchor.
- [V — The Metaphysical Dimension: Meaning, Religion, and Material Reality](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_V.txt): Culture, meaning, and religion: meaning infrastructure (§5.6b), acute meaning-collapse triage (§5.6c).
- [VI — Power: The Variable That Cannot Be Left Implicit](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_VI.txt): Institutional power, asymmetry, complexity as power resource, systemic opacity.
- [VII — How to Organize: Politics, Institutions, and the State](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_VII.txt): The authoritative 5-stage capture sequence (§7.3c-i) and early detection matrix (§7.3b).
- [VIII — Society, Culture, and the Politics of Material Outcomes](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_VIII.txt): Intersectional analysis, meritocracy critique, and structural visibility suppression.
- [IX — The International Dimension: Geopolitics and Global Order](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_IX.txt): Geopolitics, resource flows, material selection, critical minerals, and state dynamics.
- [X — How Systems Change: Adaptive Dynamics and Historical Transformation](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_X.txt): Political strategy, threshold conditions, reform vs revolution, counter-power, and coalition width.
- [XI — The Economic Doctrine](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_XI.txt): Economics without prior commitments, structural incentives, and accountability-contestability.
- [XII — How This Framework Operates](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_XII.txt): Methodology, stress-testing, genealogical critique, and technocratic drift safeguards.
- [XIII — Tensions That Cannot Be Resolved — Only Managed](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_XIII.txt): Permanent tensions, horizon boundaries, and PMN analytical limits.
- [XV — The Formula Architecture](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_XV.txt): Diagnostic formulas (§15.0b), transformation pressure ($T = S \cdot D \cdot P \cdot G$), and compressed core (§15.15).
- [XVI — Technology as Structural Variable](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_XVI.txt): Technology, AI, automation, and distributed post-biological cognition.
- [XVII — Cases and the Individual: Pattern, Drift, and the Demands of the Framework](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_XVII.txt): Individual conduct, praxis, detecting personal drift, and acting within institutions.
- [XIV — Summary: Framework, Doctrine, and What Remains Open](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_XIV.txt): Framework transmission, institutional integrity, and self-capture diagnosis (§14.6).
- [Coda — Coda](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_Coda.txt): Framework synthesis and closing scholarly context.
- [Intellectual Debts — Intellectual Debts](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_Intellectual_Debts.txt): Scholarly engagement with historical and contemporary traditions.
- [Bibliography — Bibliography](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/txt/part_Bibliography.txt): Complete academic references and citations (97 scholarly sources).

## Structured Data Endpoints

- [Glossary (239 Terms)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/gl.json): Canonical vocabulary definitions with section cross-references.
- [Glossary Categories](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/glg.json): Grouped terminology across 16 conceptual domains.
- [Per-Part JSON](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_VII.json): Each Part as JSON with section HTML (`data/parts/part_<Part>.json`, e.g. part_I, part_Intellectual_Debts). The plain-text files above carry the same text with fewer tokens.
- [Parts Manifest](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/manifest.json): Hierarchical structure of all 21 parts and 235 sections.
- [Semantic Graph](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/rel.json): Relationship graph linking conceptual sections.
- [Analytical Quotes](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/quotes.json): 25 core analytical aphorisms.
